subject: Next steps — MentorOps panel: attendee mapping, MQL transfer & SDR playbook
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai, devon@mentorops.com, sarah@metricflow.io, sales@solace-systems.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks + attendee export / recommended MQL mapping / asks

Hi everyone —

Thanks again for joining the MentorOps x Redwood panel this morning — great conversation on latency-sensitive LLM workloads. Quick follow-up with the attendee export and a proposed MQL mapping so Sales can start outreach tomorrow. Attached: mentorops-attendee-export-20270712.csv and a short action plan (postwebinar-action-plan-v1.docx). Replay: https://redwoodinference.app/replay/mentorops-20270712

Summary (high level):
- Total registrants: 1,240; attended live: 410; joined by companies: ~320
- Suggested MQL buckets: HOT / WARM / ENGAGE_ONLY (criteria below)

Proposed MQL mapping (please review):
- HOT: Product/Platform questions + existing infra (self-identified on poll) OR C-level/infrastructure leads from companies >200 employees. Recommended outreach: AE intro + 30-min deep-dive.
- WARM: Product interest + security/compliance questions OR engineering managers at startups (20–200 employees). Recommended outreach: SDR + 20-min discovery.
- ENGAGE_ONLY: Interested in content, not currently buying. Add to newsletter + nurture cadence.

Immediate asks (timeline: please ack by EOD Wed):
1) Ben — create HubSpot list and push top 30 HOT accounts into the 'ASAP-AE-Intro' queue. Include HubSpot record ids in the sheet.
2) Marissa — claim 12 HOT accounts by EOD Thu and start outreach (template in the playbook).
3) Sean — can you support a warm AE repeatable intro for HOTs if any ask for pricing?
4) Devon/Sarah/Solace — thanks for co-promoting; if you want a special partner outreach list, flag it and we'll mark partner-touch.

Notes on prioritization: I applied a simple scoring: company size + poll signal + product-fit tags from registration. See column "priority_score" in CSV. If you want different weightings, let me know; I can regenerate.

Attachments: mentorops-attendee-export-20270712.csv (first sheet: registrant info), postwebinar-action-plan-v1.docx (high-level playbook).

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
---
Redwood Inference | https://redwood.ai

On Mon, Jul 12, 2027 at 09:20 Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi everyone —
> 
> Thanks again for joining the MentorOps x Redwood panel this morning ...

Thanks Priya — I pulled the CSV and did an initial HubSpot import. I routed accounts into a "MentorOps-Jul12" pipeline with owner placeholders: SDR:marissa.cole / AE:unassigned.

Quick plan (SDR assignment + playbook):
- I attached sdr_playbook_v1.pdf with the cadence & scripts. Main points:
  1) Day 0 (email): Personalized replay + 1-line value note + CTA to schedule 20-min discovery.
  2) Day 2 (call): Short intro + ask about infra pain + ask to connect to AE for PoC talk.
  3) Day 5 (email): Case study + product collateral if no answer.
- Lead scoring: priority_score >= 70 -> HOT; 50–69 -> WARM; <50 -> ENGAGE_ONLY.
- HubSpot tags to add: webinar:mentorops_jul12, channel:webinar, source:partner-mentorops

Top 10 HOT accounts (sample) — HubSpot ID in parens:
1) MetricFlow (hs_100238) — Sarah Lin (sarah@metricflow.io) — priority_score: 88
2) Oakbridge Health (hs_100545) — VP infra listed — priority_score: 83
3) Solace Systems (hs_100672) — sales@solace-systems.com — priority_score: 80

Action items I completed:
- Created HubSpot list: MentorOps-Webinar-Jul12 (link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/objects/0-8765)
- Uploaded attendee CSV and set initial owner to marissa.cole for HOTs

Next steps: Marissa — claim the ones you want and mark "claimed_by_sdr" property. Priya — if you want me to auto-assign AE owners for HOTs, give me the list or a rule (e.g., by region or account size).

Attachments: sdr_playbook_v1.pdf

—Ben

ben.carter@redwood.ai

Thanks — I'm on it. Quick note: I've claimed 12 HOT accounts (see HubSpot list) and prioritized the top 5 for calls today and tomorrow morning.

Planned cadence for claimed HOTs:
- Day 0: Personalized email with 60s highlight + replay link
- Day 1–2: Phone call attempt (three attempts over 48 hrs)
- Day 4: AE intro if they show product interest or ask for pricing

I'll update the "claimed_by_sdr" property in HubSpot as I go and drop summary notes for each attempt. If anyone wants me to deprioritize a specific account, say so before EOD today.

—Marissa

Thanks Priya — appreciate the fast turnaround and the export. Great session today. A couple things from our side: 

1) Could we get the partner-marked list (those who selected "partner interest") as a separate CSV? I'll run our partner nurture.
2) A couple of our attendees asked about a short trial and pricing band. Can you loop in an AE to coordinate a pilot timeline? Sean Gallagher (cc'd earlier) would be a great match; if he's busy, happy to meet whoever you recommend.

Also, Sarah Lin at MetricFlow asked for a customer reference call; are you able to connect her to a similar use-case customer?

If you can send the partner CSV and an intro to AE by EOD Wed, that would help our co-marketing timeline.

Best,
